## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — When saving to `missing/report.txt` under a nonexistent parent directory, `save_report` discards `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns `0`. Propagate the exception or return a failure status with an actionable error instead of announcing success. — Callers believe the report was saved although no output file exists.
